evals.prompt: Prepare a dry-run synthetic platform stress plan for 4 CPU workers at 75% load, 2 GPU workers, and 20 seconds. Do not launch stress-ng. Show the exact planned command, safety checks, confirmation gate, and how real GPU activity would be verified.
evals.expected_output: Provide a Planned Load table with validated parameters, fail-closed preconditions, dry-run confirmation outcome, GPU verification methods, and transient cleanup guidance without claiming stress-ng ran.
expectations: Uses an absolute stress_gen.sh command with cpus=4, load=75, gpu=2, and duration=20s
Lists script, stress-ng, CPU ceiling, input, existing-process, render-node, and Intel-host checks
Renders the Planned Load table before confirmation and says dry-run/declined outcomes do not launch
Explains that GPU worker presence is insufficient and names intel_gpu_top, GFXWatt, or render-node holders as verification signals
Includes bounded synchronous execution, exit-code/activity evidence, and transient stop guidance as post-launch behavior without claiming it occurred
